snippet.title: AMBER COUNTY - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
TWITTER - https://twitter.com/TheFafri 
ITCH.IO - https://fafri.itch.io/amber-county

Gameplay trailer of Amber County, the hybrid adventure that mixes puzzles and narrative just like the old Point and Click games do. 

Solve puzzles and live the the mysterious journey of Steven O'Hara, the blind detective who solves cases using his "dreams".

Platform: PC 
Release date: Chapter 1 - 12th December 2018
